description: Check a CAP-Shield pass you were given: signature against CAP-Shield's published keys, issuer, expiry, and, if you give them, audience and required scope. No key needed. Returns valid true/false with the reason and the claims. It cannot tell you whether acts_for is TRUE, only that a key holder claimed it.

audience.description: Your own identifier. Omit only if any audience is fine.

required_scope.description: Key/value pairs that must be in cap_scope.

name: verify_pass
title: Verify a signed agent pass
